name: Arlington Memorial Bridge
note: Roadway is bike-legal end to end and one authority throughout; the midpoint heuristic must not split it.

name: Key Bridge
note: Bike provision is a narrow sidewalk. Must be trail-class on the no-trail variant so a mass ride is never routed onto it.

name: Chain Bridge
note: Five-foot sidewalk with no way off mid-span.

name: 14th Street Bridge (Mount Vernon Trail connection)
note: Several parallel structures under different authorities; not one bridge and not one answer.

name: Woodrow Wilson Bridge path
note: Separate structure from the roadway; the Jones Point sliver is the short-crossing case.

name: Sousa Bridge (Pennsylvania Avenue SE)
note: Anacostia crossing usable by a mass ride.

name: 11th Street Bridge
note: Local span carries bikes; the freeway spans do not.
